capital.evidence_quote: Kingstown is the capital and chief commercial port of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines

currency.evidence_quote: The Eastern Caribbean Dollar (XCD) is pegged to the USD at 2.70 XCD to 1 USD; USD is widely accepted

sources.title: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Meteorological Services

timezone.evidence_quote: The archipelago operates on Atlantic Standard Time UTC-4 with no daylight saving time

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential single-phase voltage across the islands is 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid frequency throughout the multi-island state is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: British Type G plugs predominate in modern buildings, alongside US Type A and European Type C outlets

police.evidence_quote: Dial 999 or 911 for emergency police response across the islands

sources.title: Milton Cato Memorial Hospital Emergency Services

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 911 or +1 784 456-1955 for emergency ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 999 for fire and rescue emergency operations

general.evidence_quote: 999 is the central unified emergency operations number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourism security liaison unit operates in Kingstown at +1 784 457-1211

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Saint Vincent ve Grenadinler son derece sakin ve güvenli bir yelken cennetidir; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is a tranquil sailing destination; exercise normal travel precautions.
advisory_headline.de: St. Vincent und die Grenadinen ist ein friedliches Segelparadies; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Сент-Винсент и Гренадины — спокойный архипелаг и рай для яхтинга; действуют обычные правила.
advisory_headline.es: San Vicente y las Granadinas es un destino náutico pacífico y seguro; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in St. Vincent reach approximately 35.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds measure 65.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Digicel and Flow provide 4G prepaid SIMs at Argyle International Airport (SVD). High-speed catamarans and inter-island schooners connect St. Vincent with Bequia, Mustique, Canouan, Mayreau, and Union Island.

sources.title: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Tourism Authority

esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: SIM card registration requires valid passport presentation

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 82%, predominantly Anglican, Methodist, Pentecostal, and Roman Catholic)

sources.title: Statistical Office of St. Vincent and the Grenadines

religion.evidence_quote: Christian faith traditions anchor festive and civic gatherings across the 32 islands

festivals.value: Vincy Mas (June/July summer carnival with Soca Monarch), Nine Mornings Christmas Festival, Bequia Easter Regatta
festivals.evidence_quote: Vincy Mas is the hottest summer carnival in the Eastern Caribbean featuring calypso and steelpan

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Wearing camouflage clothing of any kind is strictly prohibited by law for civilians and tourists. Removing coral or marine life from Tobago Cays Marine Park carries heavy fines. Follow official NEMO advisories regarding La Soufrière volcano.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Civilian possession or wearing of camouflage material is strictly prohibited under the Criminal Code

tipping.value: A 10% service charge is usually included in hotel and restaurant bills; an additional 5-10% cash tip is standard for attentive service.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% service charge is standard in hospitality invoices
